name: scribble-scramble
description: A realtime browser party game of fast, rotating minigames with a hand-drawn look.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @scribble/server" "npm run dev -w @scribble/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @scribble/client && npm run build -w @scribble/server
